name: a3ntech
description: Atlas, the a3n-tech agentic team toolkit: PAUL owns milestones and phases, the mattpocock skills own tickets, a brain repo holds team context, and session hooks hand work between people. /a3ntech:setup bootstraps a repo.

handoff.title: Session-end handoff
handoff.description: On a ticket branch, end of session commits WIP, pushes, opens a draft PR and comments a handoff on the issue (private repos only). Turn off to keep everything local.

brain_dir.title: Brain clones folder
brain_dir.description: Optional. Folder that holds one clone per brain (<folder>/<owner>/<name>). Empty uses the plugin data folder.
